messages:
Ryan M.: Hey folks — I addressed the requested changes on the API shim. switched to returning 400 for invalid headers, kept backward compat behind a flag, and added unit tests. branch: feature/api-shim-400 (force-pushed). would appreciate a quick review, mostly nits + one test adjustment.

Elaine: thanks — quick question: did you preserve the old header behavior for the internal client? we still have a rollout using it.

Ryan M.: yes, preserved it behind ENABLE_LEGACY_HEADERS with default=false. added a short note in the README and a snippet in docs/api.md. also added a changelog entry.

Samir: i'll take a look in ~1h. noticed CI is flaky on macos-latest in other PRs today; any special smoke steps i should run locally?

Ryan M.: no special steps, basic smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh api-shim`. CI shows one flaky test TestHeaderRoundtrip — i skipped it with a TODO and filed INF-3421.

CI Bot: Build 4832 finished — all checks passed except macos-latest (flaky). details: https://ci.redwood/4832 :white_check_mark:

Elaine: reading now. small nit on the helper name (suggest getLegacyHeader -> parseLegacyHeader) but not a blocker. approve once you squash the fixup. :+1:

Samir: left one comment about switching the debug log to trace to avoid noise. otherwise LGTM. if you can squash the fixup commit and re-run CI we can target the 18:00 canary window.

Ryan M.: i squashed and force-pushed, re-ran CI. added changelog under docs/changes/2026-03-17.md. holding merge until canary capacity confirmed — @Oncall-SRE can you confirm 18:00 ET slot?

Oncall-SRE: Canary at 18:00 ET looks available, go ahead to merge after CI green. i'll monitor the rollout. :thumbsup:

Ryan M.: great, thanks. merging after final CI green and will watch the canary. will post a short rollback plan in the deploy channel before merging.
